review_candidates.title: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Server OS Administrator
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Job Description Role Summary We are seeking a Senior Server OS Administrator with deep expertise in managing Oracle Linux, Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL), and Windows Server operating systems across Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) and hybrid environments. This role is responsible for OS provisioning, hardening, patching, performance tuning, automation, and compliance ensuring enterprise compute workloads operate with maximum availability, security, and operational efficiency on OCI. review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Job Description Role Summary We are seeking a Senior Server OS Administrator with deep expertise in managing Oracle Linux, Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL), and Windows Server operating systems across Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) and hybrid environments. Required Skills & Experience 8–10 years of progressive experience in server OS administration with hands-on expertise across Oracle Linux, RHEL, and Windows Server. Strong proficiency in OS automation using Ansible and at least one scripting language: Bash, Python, or PowerShell. Hands-on experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform with OCI provider) for compute provisioning.
